Geometric analysis & partial differential equations

Rui Gao

Associate Research Fellow

Shaanxi Normal University

I am an Associate Research Fellow at Shaanxi Normal University, where I have been since July 2026. My research lies in geometric analysis and partial differential equations.

I received my Ph.D. in Mathematics from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in June 2026, under the supervision of Professor Miaomiao Zhu. Before that, I studied Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at China University of Mining and Technology.

Research

My research centers on geometric variational problems in higher codimension, with a particular emphasis on the existence and compactness of surfaces with prescribed mean curvature in Riemannian manifolds. I study these questions in arbitrary codimension through min-max methods, bubbling analysis, and Morse index estimates, alongside related problems for harmonic maps and minimal surfaces.

  • Min-max constructions of branched immersed H-spheres and free boundary H-disks in arbitrary codimension.
  • Energy identities, no-neck properties, and Morse index estimates for harmonic maps and approximate H-surfaces, including the free boundary setting.
  • Parallel mean curvature surfaces in higher codimension, prescribed contact angles, and codimension reduction.
